description: This file contains a utility function named 'shapeAgentGroupedSeries' that processes a list of cost records, grouping and aggregating them by agent and a secondary dimension (such as environment or cost category). The function prepares data suitable for visualization in a charting library like Recharts, ensuring consistent categories across agents.

methods.name: shapeAgentGroupedSeries(records, groupBy = "environment", options)
methods.description: Transforms raw cost records into a grouped dataset format suitable for visualization, with optional sorting and handling of unknown categories.
